captain_command.if_q_horn_recognized: Do not declare TRUMP finished. Preregister a separate standard q-Horn terminal integration and independent SAT/UNSAT replay.
captain_command.if_q_horn_rejected: Stop terminal-class shopping on this one fixpoint. Open the universal fixpoint coverage/remainder obligation: prove why every reachable nonterminal fixpoint must be decided or make certified progress.

method.independent_replay: if rejected, derive a deletion-minimal q-Horn-infeasible clause core and exhaustively test every ternary valuation of the core variables using a separate direct evaluator
method.primary_recognizer: deterministic exact CSP/backtracking over ternary beta values with sound partial-clause pruning
method.reason: R39 answers only whether the sealed R38 fixpoint is q-Horn. It does not promote the local exhaustive recognizer to the literature's general linear-time recognition algorithm.

q_horn_definition.clause_condition: FOR_EACH clause C: SUM_{l in C} beta(l) <= 1
q_horn_definition.membership: F is q-Horn iff such a valuation exists

reference.paper: Recognition of q-Horn formulae in linear time
